evidence.explanation: The foundational paper explicitly calls the relationships empirical. Its abstract describes measured relationships between loss, model size, data and training compute.
The newer inference-scaling work derives its allocation strategy from observed experimental results. It tests trained revision models and search methods, rather than asserting a physical law.

OpenAI presents o1's reasoning improvements through training observations and benchmark tests. This supports the empirical characterization, although this announcement does not itself specify a scaling equation.
